title.ko: It is … that · What … is · The reason why … is
title.en: It is … that · What … is · The reason why … is

explain.ko: 분열문은 문장의 한 부분을 강조하기 위해 문장을 둘로 나누는 구조입니다. 첫째, It is/was + 강조할 부분 + that/who …: It was Mr Kim who solved the problem. 사람은 who, 사물·장소·시간은 that을 씁니다. 둘째, What + 주어 + 동사 + is/was …(의사 분열문): What I need is enough rest. 셋째, The reason why …, The place where … 처럼 이유·장소를 강조합니다. 말할 때는 억양과 함께, 글에서는 핵심을 분명히 하고 싶을 때 씁니다.
explain.en: Cleft sentences split a sentence in two to emphasise one part. First, It is/was + emphasised part + that/who …: It was Mr Kim who solved the problem (who for people; that for things, places, time). Second, wh-clefts: What + subject + verb + is/was …: What I need is enough rest. Third, The reason why … / The place where … Use them in speech with stress, or in writing to make the key point clear.

notes.ko: 분열문은 강조할 부분을 be 동사의 뒤로 보냅니다.
notes.en: The emphasised part comes after the verb be.

notes.ko: What 분열문의 주어는 보통 단수로 취급합니다. What I need is two things.
notes.en: A what-cleft usually takes a singular verb.

notes.ko: that은 who, which, when, where로 바뀔 수 있습니다.
notes.en: That can be replaced by who, which, when or where.
